Run my audit — $98.28

Questions

Everything you'd ask before pressing the button.

What exactly do I get for $98.28?

A complete 7-agent diagnostic and a consulting-grade PDF report: your AI Leverage Score (0–100) across 4 critical dimensions, a Revenue Leakage Analysis with 4–5 quantified leak points, Workflow Bottleneck Mapping, a custom AI Agent Deployment Blueprint with 5–6 agents designed for your business, ROI projections, and a prioritized 30/60/90 day roadmap — delivered to your inbox within 2–4 hours.

How is this different from asking ChatGPT?

A single chat gives you a single generalist take. The swarm runs seven specialized agents in parallel, each with its own analytical mandate, then a Queen agent cross-examines and reconciles their findings into one coherent verdict. Structure, adversarial review, and synthesis are the product — not just the model underneath.

What is the Hive™?

The Hive is our founding member community — and the engine of something bigger. MoltyBeeAI™ starts with audits, then implementation, then a full Intelligence Platform that continuously optimizes how organizations work. Every audit feeds anonymized, aggregated intelligence that sharpens benchmarks and blueprints for every member after you. Founding members lock beta pricing, get first access to each phase as it ships, and shape what gets built. You're early — that's the point.

Who is this for?

Founders and operators of revenue-driven businesses — SaaS, services, e-commerce, creators — who want an honest, prioritized read on where their revenue leaks and what to fix first. If you're pre-revenue, it will still sharpen your offer and pricing before launch.

How long does it take?

The intake takes about 10–15 minutes — the more context you give the swarm, the sharper your diagnostic. Your professional PDF report is delivered within 2–4 hours.

Is my business data safe?

Yes. Your intake data is used solely to generate your audit, payments run through PayPal's secure checkout, and we never sell your data. Full details are in our Privacy Policy.

Why is beta pricing only $98.28?

We're scaling the Hive. Early members get founding pricing in exchange for feedback and word of mouth. As the report library, benchmarks, and agent capabilities grow, pricing moves toward its real value.

Last call

By tonight you can know
what most founders never will.

Your competitors are guessing. You don't have to. Deploy the swarm, get the verdict — and take your seat in the Hive while it's still early enough to matter.

Deploy the swarm — $98.28
